title: Scythe To Meet You
description: A Fabric mod adding scythes as both weapon and tool!
body:
# Scythe To Meet You!
##### A re-write of a mod I _almost_ made two years ago!

-----

Adds scythes to the game, as both a weapon and tool!

Scythes can be used to harvest crops and auto-replant them!

As a weapon, they aim to be usable in pvp while not outclassing vanilla weapons! Both their attack speed and damage are between the axe and sword, whilst keeping the sweeping attack of the sword!

##### Attack balancing may change once I talk to someone who actually pvps often :p
